# CN IP parser fixture

`chnroutes.mmdb` was retrieved on 2026-09-13 from
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/misakaio/chnroutes2/master/chnroutes.mmdb
for regression testing the user-requested chnroutes2 MMDB compatibility.
It contains public IP routing facts and preserves the upstream binary layout,
including its missing description metadata and unused dictionary data.
